entities.name: Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases

entities.summary: The Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases is an infectious disease hospital in the Italian city of Rome. The institute is named for the eighteenth-century Italian biologist Lazzaro Spallanzani.
